effects: Anyone who holds the signature can call castVoteBySig while the proposal is Active. That casts the signer's vote on proposalId with the choice `support` (0 Against, 1 For, 2 Abstain).
The vote counts the signer's full delegated ARB voting power at the proposal snapshot. That weight is read from the token checkpoints, not from the message.
The signer is marked as having voted on this proposal, so they cannot vote on it again or change the vote.
No tokens or ETH move and no approval is set. The signature has no nonce or deadline and stays usable for as long as the proposal is Active.
formats.shown: "Cast vote on Arbitrum Core Governor proposal", with the proposal id as a raw integer and the vote choice as For, Against or Abstain.

findings.title: Ballot: the intent leaves out the vote choice, and there is no interpolatedIntent to carry it.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats Ballot: intent "Cast vote on Arbitrum Core Governor proposal" and no interpolatedIntent. The choice only appears in the 'Vote' field (cases 0/1/2 show For/Against/Abstain).
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as "Vote {support} on Arbitrum Core Governor proposal {proposalId}".

findings.title: Ballot: the proposal id is a 77-digit hash, so the signer cannot tell which proposal it is.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json field proposalId format "raw". Case 0 shows 65188298694973145982045139804621336162807822964285913299589753047294933677132. In GovernorUpgradeable the proposalId is a hash of the proposal's targets, values, calldatas and description.
findings.fix: No descriptor format can resolve a proposal id to its title. A wallet would need off-chain metadata.

findings.title: Ballot: the vote weight comes from storage and the signature never expires; neither is on the screen.
findings.evidence: GovernorUpgradeable._castVote: `uint256 weight = _getVotes(account, proposal.voteStart.getDeadline(), params);`. castVoteBySig recovers the signer from only (BALLOT_TYPEHASH, proposalId, support), with no nonce or deadline. Re-use is blocked only by `hasVoted` in GovernorCountingSimpleUpgradeable._countVote.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The values are not in the message.
